characters.name: Elena Gilbert
characters.description: Elena is the novel series' heroine and protagonist (opposite Stefan Salvatore), and the female lead character (except Dark Reunion). She was born Nov 5, 1992 in Fells Church, Virginia. She is the oldest child and elder daughter of Thomas Gilbert and Elizabeth Gilbert. She has a younger sister, Margaret. Her parents died, leaving her and sister to live with their uncle and aunt Gilbert. Elena is seventeen at the beginning of the very first book, and she is the most beautiful, popular girl at Robert E. Lee High School (mainly called the Queen). She is normally confident and ambitious on top of being beautiful; not surprisingly, she also shows manyAlpha Bitchtraits like selfishness and boastfulness. She does grow out of it after meeting her soulmate Stefan, however, and her second death in the series (after becoming a vampire) is to protect those she cares for. The Ace/Broken Ace: Elena possesses everything: popularity, status, beauty, and intelligence. She is renowned as the Queen of the school and the most popular girl at Robert E. Lee High. She is also highly attractive to the opposite sex. Elena holds the title of the most beautiful girl in Fells Church. She is stunningly beautiful and possesses the looks of a model. Elena, aGo-Getter Girl, has been crowned Homecoming Queen multiple times. She actively participates in various school activities, maintains good grades (except in math or trigonometry), and is highly popular due to her sociable nature, making many friends. Elena also dated Matt, the star athlete of the school, and eventually fell in love with Stefan, theBig Man on Campusand the most popular and desired boy in school. Elena eventually discovers her special destiny as an earth guardian, tasked with defending the world against evil forces and beings. Elena may appear to have it all, but deep down she is profoundly broken and has endured significant tragedy and adversity at a young age. Elena lost her parents at a young age and never fully recovered from t

characters.name: Stefan Salvatore
characters.description: Stefan is the novel series' hero, male protagonist, and male lead character. He was born July 5, 1490 in Florence, Italy. He is the youngest child and younger son of Conte Giuseppe Salvatore and Contessa Salvatore. He has an older brother, Damon. Stefan is a 500+ year old immortal born during the time of The Renaissance (during the fifteenth century), who was one of the Salvatore brothers that fell deeply in love with a young beautiful German girl who was a vampire, Katherine Von Schwarzschild, during his human life and before he was transformed into a vampire when he was a 17 year old human noble. Stefan arrives in Fells Church to start a new life and live amongst humans and enrolls as a high school student at Robert E. Lee High School to blend in like a regular teenager. It is there, where Stefan meets Elena Gilbert. He fell for her at first sight, but because Elena bears a striking resemblance to his past and first love, Katherine, he repeatedly tries to avoid her at all costs during the beginning of the series. Abusive Parents: Stefan's father Giuseppe was an abusive man. He was not, however, abusive towards Stefan, but was abusive towards Damon. The Ace: No matter what Stefan does, he'll always turn out to be exceptional at it. Whether it's with romance, sports, education, leadership, etc. This has caused other male characters such as Damon, Tyler and even his best friend, Matt to be both admirable and envious of Stefan. Action Hero: Stefan is often involved amidst all of the action in the series, normally alongsideElena. Actual Pacifist: Stefan dislikes using physical violence in most circumstances. However, if he is forced to use violence or kill, expect Stefan toangst and broodabout it afterwards. Stefan hates killing and has never killed a human throughout his immortal life.

characters.name: Damon Salvatore
characters.description: Damon is the novel series' anti-hero and main antagonist. He was born on Oct 31, 1487 in Florence, Italy. He is the eldest child and elder son of Conte Giuseppe Salvatore and Contessa Salvatore. He has a younger brother, Stefan. Along with Stefan, he fell in love with a young German girl who was a vampire, Katherine Von Schwarzschild, during his human life and before he was transformed into a vampire in his early twenties. Damon desires to make Elena his Princess of Darkness, offer her the gift of immortality and live in the darkness and shadows for eternity together. However, Elena has repeatedly rejected Damon's wishes and advances, resulting in an angry, jealous and resentful Damon. Elena eventually reciprocates Damon's feelings; however, Elena still chooses her soulmate Stefan over him time and time again. Abusive Parents: His father Giuseppe, who was physically abusive and violent towards Damon. Affably Evil: Although Damon consistently engages in immoral acts, he does so in a subtle and polite manner. Damon is not a straightforward antagonist; instead, he manipulates and charms others to achieve his goals. Damon, a wealthy nobleman during the Renaissance period, exudes sophistication in his demeanor. He is also a highly persuasive individual who uses his charm to manipulate others into fulfilling his desires or doing his bidding. Damon is aMan of Wealth and TasteandWicked Cultured. He has the ability to appear pleasant, polite, and friendly when he chooses, but he can also be quite sarcastic. Damon has demonstrated that he is not entirely evil and is capable of performing acts of goodness when he chooses to. Throughout the series, it is evident that Damon suppresses his humanity, opting to conceal it due to his fear of appearing weak or vulnerable. Damon's humanity is evident in his actions and interactions with Elena, Stefan, and particularly Bonnie. Despite Damon's selfish motives in pursuing Elena and trying to steal her from his brother, he has also demons

characters.name: BonnieMcCullough
characters.description: Bonnie is the second female lead of the series after Elena and one of Elena's best friends. She was born on Mar 10, 1992 in Fells Church, Virginia. She is the youngest child and the younger daughter of ColinMcCulloughand AilsaMcCullough. She has an older sister, Mary. She also ends up competing with Elena in feelings for Damon — unusual because of her bubbley and cheerful personality, which contrast with Damon's dark brooding, though it turns out she is stronger and braver than she looks. A-Cup Angst: Bonnie frequently expresses dissatisfaction with her lack of breast size. She frequently complains about feeling more like a child than a young woman due to her small breasts. Due to her small chest size, she has always felt insecure about her appearance and physical attractiveness. Bonnie wears push-up or padded bras to enhance her small bust size. Bonnie has expressed feelings of jealousy towards Elena, Meredith, and Caroline due to their larger bust sizes. This has caused Bonnie to feel less feminine, despite being the most girly and feminine among the group of girls. Bonnie's inferiority complex is exacerbated by the fact that she is perceived as a child who requires constant protection within the core group. Damon has observed that Bonnie is not completely flat-chested and describes her as a solid A cup, indicating that she has some size in the chest area. Action Girl: Bonnie frequently finds herself in the midst of all the action, just like Elena and Meredith. Bonnie is the resident witch in the series. Bonnie, despite her petite and small stature, is arguably the most powerful female character and the strongest among the girls in terms of power. This is due to her exceptional abilities as a psychic witch. At the beginning, Bonnie is portrayed as fragile, vulnerable, and weak, resembling more of aDamsel in Distress. She consistently fainted or passed out whenever she attempted to use her strong powers due to her lack of control over them. Over time, she has learn

characters.name: Meredith Sulez
characters.description: Action Girl: Like all of the other female characters, Meredith often finds herself amidst all of the action. Let's not forget that Meredith is also a badass vampire slayer. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: She is tall, brunette and she is intensely cool and logical. Sometimes she can come off as aloof to others. In fact, Meredith is the only person who is not turned on by Damon's charms. She is the only character in the series who actually "scares" Damon. Badass Normal: Meredith is badass but she possesses no special powers and abilities. She is a normal human girl. Big Sister Instinct: To Bonnie. Although they are the same age, Meredith treats Bonnie as a younger sibling and is highly protective of her. Brainy Brunette: Meredith is highly intelligent, smart and capable and she is known as the brains in her circle of friends. She is probably the smartest female character in the entire series, even more so than Elena.

characters.name: Matthew "Matt" Honeycutt
characters.description: Academic Athlete: Matt is academic and a star athlete. He was the star quarterback of his high school football team and even received a scholarship to go to college. The All-American Boy: Matt is blond, attractive, clean cut and a star athlete. He's the classic all American (nice) guy. Better as Friends: With Elena and Bonnie. Matt had romantic relationships with both Elena and Bonnie. However, even though Matt still harbored feelings for Elena after they broke up, he started to accept that he and Elena were much better off as just being friends. Matt also dates Bonnie briefly, but also realizes that he and Bonnie are just friends. Dogged Nice Guy: To Elena. Although Elena and Matt break up, Matt is still in love with Elena and believes that there might have been a chance for the two of them to get back together, even though Elena developed a romantic relationship with Stefan. The Generic Guy: Matt is the just the nice human guy who is loyal to all of his friends. He doesn't possess any superhuman abilities and has no special mission or destiny that awaits him.

characters.name: Caroline Forbes
characters.description: Elena'sotherbest friend. She's a bubbly girl who's a descendant of one of the founding families of Mystic Falls. Action Girl: After she gets turned into a vampire, she becomes the most active female combatant in the cast. Action Survivor: Before she was turned into a vampire. Though she was a regular human, she was able to survive being amongst all the supernatural beings around her. She upgrades to anAction Girlonce she becomes a vampire in season two. Adaptation Dye-Job: In the novel series, Caroline has auburn red hair but on the show, Caroline is a blonde. Adaptational Nice Guy: In the novel series, Caroline is anAlpha Bitchwhose relationship with Elena is much more antagonistic. In the show, she has shades of being anAlpha Bitchin season one, but quickly develops and becomes one of the nicest characters.

characters.name: Alaric K. Saltzman
characters.description: Badass Bookworm: Alaric is very intelligent and a history teacher ...and he's also a vampire hunter. He's competent and fit and can fight. Badass Normal: Alaric is a human with no superhuman abilities, but he can take down vampires. Badass Teacher: Alaric is a vampire hunter aside from being the high school teacher. The Smart Guy: Alaric is intelligent, scholarly and well-educated. He travels abroad to study. Vampire Hunter: Aside from being the high school's history teacher, Alaric also researches about vampires and is a vampire hunter on the side.

characters.name: Katherine Von Schwartzschild
characters.description: Katherine was the young and beautiful a vampire whom Stefan and Damon fell in love with during the Italian Renaissance 500 years ago. She was a sickly girl when she was human, so her maid sought out a vampire named Klaus to turn her, meaning she became much stronger although, as with most vampires, she was still weakened by the sun. Ax-Crazy: She had grown to be crazy, devious and insane, but most of this had to due withKlaus' influence on her. Back from the Dead: InDestiny Rising,Katherine is reborn by Klaus. It is discovered that Katherine is actually Elena's half sister through the same birth mother, who was a Guardian. The Beautiful Elite: Katherine is rich, beautiful and of high status. Beauty Is Bad: Katherine is very beautiful but she is evil at the same time.

characters.name: Klaus
characters.description: Klaus is a pureblood vampire, one of the 'Old Ones' who has never been a human, and he existed long ago before the pyramids were built, which was 2500 BC. According to him, he fought in the Trojan War and helped cause the downfall of the Roman Empire. He is some strange cross between mad and evil, possibly due to his age, and nearly kills Stefan at one point. A God Am I: Klaus is an Old One, meaning the most powerful, oldest vampire living on Earth. He is also aMonster Progenitor, the origin of all living vampires. Klaus makes it frequently known to others who he is and how powerful he is, thinking of himself as a Godlike being. Ax-Crazy: Klaus is crazy, wicked, sociopathic, sadistic, sinister and purely evil. He has zero conscience. Back from the Dead:InDestiny Rising, Klaus is resurrected or reborn. Bad Powers, Bad People: As a an Old One, he is one of the most powerful vampires ever yet he abuses his powers to hurt others.

characters.name: Sage
characters.description: Finn's lover and the first vampire he ever sired as well as Damon's old friend and mentor. Action Girl: She's one of the strongest female characters on the show, being a centuries-old vampire that easily overpowers Stefan and Caroline. She's even introduced in a boxing match. Adaptation Dye-Job: Brunnette in the original novel, a redhead in the show. Adaptation Species Change: In the novels he's part angel, being the son of the devil. In the show, Sage was a normal woman who got turned into a vampire. Ambiguously Bi: Sage seems to have an attraction towards the same sex. She seems to be highly experimental sexually.

characters.name: Jessalyn D'Aubigne
characters.description: Fiery Redhead: Jessalyn is a redhead who is sarcastic, opinionated and speaks exactly what is on her mind. Friendly Neighbourhood Vampire: Jessalyn is described to be polite, friendly, and innocent. Immortality: Because Jessalyn is a vampire, she has the ability to never physically age and to live forever. The Ingenue: Damon mentions that Jessalyn has a childlike quality, purity and innocence about her. Ojou: She is wealthy, lady like and she is often treated like a lady by others. Damon was very respectful towards her.

characters.name: Cristian Sulez
characters.description: Cristian Sulez is the twin brother of Meredith Sulez, son of the Sulez parents, and grandson of Meredith's grandfather who is in a mental ward. When Klaus attacked Cristian and Meredith, he was attempting to capture both of them but failed in capturing Meredith, instead, he got her twin brother Cristian. Meredith was half-human, half-vampire as a result. Cristian is handsome, tall, athletic, and physically fit. He has hazel eyes, and medium brown hair. Like Meredith, Cristian is fast, strong, and can be described as a powerful human hunter. Personality wise, Unlike physical attributes, his personality is the opposition that has her twin sister. At first, Cristian is kidnapped by Klaus, and his personality could be described as cold, but aware of his actions. Cristian somehow loves his family, but because of his nature, he does not return with them. After returning to being a human, Cristian is described as the black sheep of the Sulez Family. In his last days, Cristian becomes the new Old One, and in his last moments, Cristian says be proud of his sister when Klaus was destroyed once and for all. Dying Declaration of Love:As Cristian is dying in the final book, Cristian tells Meredith that he loves her and that he is proud of her and their family. Half-Identical Twins: Subverted. Cristian and Meredith are fraternal twins who strongly resemble each other, but they don't look physically identical to one another. Killed Off for Real:Cristian is killed in the final book of the series. Long Lost Sibling: To Meredith. He is her fraternal twin brother.

characters.name: Ethan Crane
characters.description: Ethan Crane, was the current president of the Vitale Society, and one of the descendants of Klaus. Ethan is the leader of the Society Vitale and a friendly student who wants Matt to join them. Ethan reveals to Stefan that one of Klaus's descendants turned him and that he plans to resurrect him at the equinox. He needs the blood of his descendants however which is where Stefan and Damon come in. Ethan was transformed by a vampire lady during his trip to Europe. Ethan is described as tall, with golden hazel eyes, curly dark hair, and of smiled warmly. Ethan is kind, wise, and a good leader. However, he has an obsession with Klaus and vampires, because his goal is the return of the Old One at all costs. Affably Evil: Ethan is polite, but he doesn't have good intentions. The Chessmaster: Ethan used the Vitale Society in order to get closer to Matt and Stefan and gain information in order to achieve his plan. Determinator: Ethan was determined to resurrect Klaus at all costs.He succeeded. Killed Off for Real:In the final book, Ethan is killed off by Klaus after his head is severed.

characters.name: Tyler Smallwood
characters.description: Beauty Is Bad: Tyler is attractive and athletic but his personality is very unbecoming. The Big Guy: Tyler is described to be very tall, towering over both Matt and especially Stefan. The Bully: Tyler spends most of his time tormenting Stefan when he first arrives at the school as a new student. Matt frequently tells Tyler to leave Stefan alone. Entitled Bastard: Tyler is highly entitled. He will expect things from others but at the same time, he is incredibly ungrateful for it afterwards. Hot-Blooded: Tyler is passionate and short-tempered.

characters.name: Caleb Smallwood
characters.description: Born in New Orleans, Louisiana, Caleb is the only child of Mr. and Mrs. Smallwood. When he was twelve, his father allowed his brother's son (his paternal cousin), Tyler, to stay with them for a short period of time. A few years later, in 1986, both Mr. Smallwood and his wife died. Later Caleb moved to Fell's Church, at home of his uncles, in early summer, after the "disappearance" of his cousin Tyler, following the fight against Klaus. Suddenly, he finds himself having memories of two conflicting realities (one that was real, and one that was made up of fake memories implanted by the Guardians). The reason he retains his real memories is because he is supernatural (not just a dormant werewolf, but also some kind of spellcaster). He sees newspaper articles depicting each reality as well, and determines from them that Elena and her friends know what has happened and why his memories are so conflicting. Hoping that they also know where Tyler is, Caleb begins doing yard work for aunt Judith, hoping to get closer to Elena so that she will tell him everything. Physically, Caleb had shaggy, dark blond hair and blue eyes. He was pale, short and weighed very little, prompting him to use a glamour to make himself seem desirable when approaching Elena. Parental Abandonment: Caleb has lost both of his parents. Something about a Rose:InPhantom, Caleb gives Elena a rose that he had "found" on a porch which might have been linked to the spell that he had cast. It turns out that he had given the rose to Elena in attempts to find out where Tyler had went.The rose in which Caleb gave to Elena was indeed used to destroy the Phantom of Jealousy; the phantom that had been feeding on the jealous of the entire group. InPhantom, Caleb gives Elena a rose that he had "found" on a porch which might have been linked to the spell that he had cast. It turns out that he had given the rose to Elena in attempts to find out where Tyler had went. The rose in which Caleb gave to Elena was indeed used

characters.name: Zander
characters.description: Zander is a benevolent werewolf who has moonlight-coloured hair, blue eyes, and was very naïve. He is an Original werewolf who was born around the XX century. He becomes a love interest for Bonnie in The Hunters trilogy. Physically, Zander is tall, gorgeous, with clear, true blue eyes, and slim torso with well-muscled arms. His features were sharply cut, the eyebrows arched, the cheekbones high, but his mouth was soft and sensual. He has pure white-blond hair. Personality wise, Zander has a noble personality, kind, gentle, compassionate and mature. He is literally Tyler's opposition or another werewolf infected, since they can not control the savagery and anger due to their wolfish nature. Beware the Nice Ones: Zander may be approachable and friendly, but don't mess with him, his friends, his pack or Bonnie. Friendly Neighbourhood Vampire: Friendly Neighbourhood Werewolf. Zander is a noble, kind-hearted and benevolent werewolf. Only One Name: Zander's surname is not revealed in the series. Really Seven Hundred Years Old: Zander physically looks like a college boy, but he is actually centuries old.

characters.name: Margaret Gilbert
characters.description: Margaret is Elena's much younger sister, who is four years old. Elena considers her to be very innocent and secretly talks to her as a vampire after her death, saying that it is not yet her time to rejoin her deceased parents. She has the platinum white-blond hair, fair, pink skin with peachy cheeks, and very light blue eyes. Margaret is generally cheerful, upbeat and optimistic, and she is empathetic enough to offer Elena Halloween candy when her older sister seems distressed. She likes animals well enough to adopt a kitten, though it turns out to be Katherine von Swartzschild in animal form. Due to her age, she gives little to no evidence of understanding the activities and concerns of her older sister or the other characters. She perceives Elena's death as her older sister's having gone to be with their parents. Her parents died when she was around one year old, so she has little memory of them. It is unknown how she spends her time or if she has any friends, as the reader only sees her with Elena or Aunt Judith. Angelic Beauty: Like her elder sister Elena, she has a rather ethereal, divine physical beauty. Cheerful Child: Margaret is optimistic and sunny in nature. She cheers up Elena whenever she is feeling upset. Children Are Innocent: Margaret is a sweet, innocent child with a kind hearted temperament. The Cutie: Margaret is sweet, innocent and adorable. Appropriate role for a young child.

characters.name: Judith Gilbert-Maxwell
characters.description: Judith is Elena's aunt and legal guardian. She is the sister of Elena and Margaret's father. She moved in with Elena and her baby sister Margaret right after the death of the girls' parents. She always looks vaguely flustered. She has a thin, mild face and flyaway red hair pushed back untidily. She is engaged to and later marries Robert Maxwell, though she briefly broke the engagement after Elena's death, thinking it was best for Margaret. She is deeply caring and one of the last people Elena talks to before dying the first time.It is revealed that Judith isn't Elena's or Margaret's aunt, she was a good friend of Elena's mother only, despite having been called "Miss Gilbert" in The Struggle and Dark Reunion. Good Parents: Judith is always there for Elena and Margaret and is incredibly supportive of both. Parental Substitute: To both Elena and Margaret. After their parents had died, Judith had become Elena and Margaret's legal guardian.

characters.name: Vickie Bennett
characters.description: Vickie was an acquaintance of Elena, Matt, Meredith and Bonnie, but she was never particularly a part of their inner circle. Physically, she was small with light brown hair and dark brown eyes. She was at the cemetery with Elena when they left the homecoming dance. She had stayed there in the church with Dick Carter, Tyler Smallwood's best friend. She was attacked by Katherine, and that caused her to go insane and she accused Elena of it. Then she is accused of killing Sue because she relapsed after her death and she was the only one present. After her transition away from the "fast crowd," her involvement is considered unlikely. When Bonnie and Meredith go to her house, she catatonically says that the murderer said she is next. She is left under the protection of Damon but is later murdered by Klaus. Back from the Dead:In Midnight, it was revealed that Vickie was alive and recovered from her death. Brainwashed and Crazy: Vickie's mind was being controlled by Katherine, which caused her to go insane. Killed Off for Real: In Dark Reunion, Vickie is brutally murdered by Klaus. In a series full of supernatural immortal beings, she is not coming back.

characters.name: Lady Ulma
characters.description: Lady Ulma was a slave in the Dark Dimension but she got rescued by Damon and Elena when they were looking for Stefan. Once a rich maiden living happily with her family in the Dark Dimension. Her family was killed by a demon she refused to marry. She then becomes a slave to Old Drohnze but is later rescued by Elena and Damon. Blue Blood: Ulma was once a wealthy woman from a noble family before she became a slave. Made a Slave: Lady Ulma was once a rich maiden but she became a slave within the Dark Dimension because of refusal to marry. Damsel in Distress: Damon and Elena end up saving her from slavery. Riches to Rags: She went from being a wealthy maid to a slave of the Dark Dimension.

characters.name: Shinichi
characters.description: Shinichi is a magical fox spirit called a "Kitsune" from Japan. He is Misao's twin brother. In the beginning of Nightfall, he appeared as a dark and mysterious person, who offered a partnership to Damon in order to destroy the entire Fell's Church. With the influence and help of Damon, Stefan is lured away from the town with the promise of becoming a human again. Asian Fox Spirit: This is Shinichi's species, alongside his twin sister, Misao. Their origin is from Japan. Kitsune are described as intelligent beings and as possessing magical abilites that increase with their age and wisdom, every 100 years they get a tail, becoming more powerful, and when they reach nine tails (Kyuubi no Kitsune), they become demi-gods, reaching the omniscience, and almost the omnipotency. Foremost among these is the ability to assume a human form. While some folktales speak of kitsune employing this ability to trick others as foxes in folklore often do other stories portray them as faithful guardians, friends, lovers and wives. The folklore says they are afraid of dogs, running away every time they see one. The Chessmaster: Shinichi is good at scheming and manipulating others to his advantage. The Corrupter: To Damon. Shinichi made terrible tentacled creatures called malach take over Damon's mind and soul, making Damon under Shinichi's complete control. Shinichi made Damon kidnap and torture Elena, while he and Misao spread the malach like a virus among the citizens of Fells Church. Half-Identical Twins: Misao is the twin of Shinichi; they look almost similar in physical appearance and are similar in terms of personality and temperament. Except Misao is a female and Shinichi is a male.

characters.name: Misao
characters.description: Misao is a magical fox spirit called a "Kitsune" from Japan. She is Shinichi's twin sister. In the beginning ofNightfall, she appeared in Caroline's mirror in her brother's form, and used her bad feelings for Elena to get her to sign a contract, which enabled Caroline to get her revenge on Elena and Stefan. Asian Fox Spirit: This is Misao's species, alongside her twin brother, Shinichi. Their origin is from Japan. Kitsune are described as intelligent beings and as possessing magical abilites that increase with their age and wisdom, every 100 years they get a tail, becoming more powerful, and when they reach nine tails (Kyuubi no Kitsune), they become demi-gods, reaching the omniscience, and almost the omnipotency. Foremost among these is the ability to assume a human form. While some folktales speak of kitsune employing this ability to trick others as foxes in folklore often do other stories portray them as faithful guardians, friends, lovers and wives. The folklore says they are afraid of dogs, running away every time they see one. The Chessmaster: Misao is manipulative, cunning and she'll often use people to her advantage whenever she wants to. Cute Monster Girl: Misao is a kitsune but in her human form, she is an attractive Japanese girl. Half-Identical Twins: Misao is the twin of Shinichi; they looks almost similar in physical appearance and are similar in terms of personality and temperament. Except Misao is a female and Shinichi is a male.

characters.name: Other Characters
characters.description: Aristocrats Are Evil: Subverted. He's a Baron but he's not evil, just overprotective and stern. Blue Blood: Baron is wealthy and aristocratic. Abusive Parent: To Damon. He would often physically and emotionally abuse Damon as a child, especially when he was drunk. Alcoholic Parent: Giuseppe became a hardcore alcoholic after his wife died, and in his alcoholic state was abusive to Damon. Archnemesis Dad: To Damon. They never got along and always clashed rather severely. In fact, Giuseppe and Damon's strained relationship caused a lot of turmoil within the family.

characters.name: Bonnie Bennett
characters.description: Bonnie was born February 5, 1993 (her zodiac sign is Aquarius) in Mystic Falls, Virginia. She is Elena's best friend and confident, who discovers that she is a witch born from a line of witches, and spends the series training her powers to protect her friends and her town. Action Girl: Bonnie is actually the first of the female good characters toTake a Level In Badass in becoming a supernatural beingas she discovers her magical powers and can fight on her own, such as against Klaus in Season 2. Adaptation Dye-Job: She was a redhead in the books. In the series, she's dark-haired and portrayed by a black actress. Adaptation Name Change: Bonnie's last name isMcCulloughin the novels. Alliterative Name: Her name is Bonnie Bennett. Her first and last name begin with the same letter:B.

characters.name: Jeremy Gilbert
characters.description: Jeremy Gilbert is Elena's younger brother. A troubled teen with self-destructive tendencies. Adaptation Dye-Job: In addition to being aged up to teenager and turned into a guy, Jeremy is also turned into a brunette like Elena. Annoying Younger Sibling: To Elena of course. There are many instances of Jeremy doing things which annoy Elena, such as drinking when he shouldn't or smoking pot at school. Elena constantly has to set Jeremy straight due to his rebellious ways. Age Lift: The character in the book is significantly younger. He's a teenager on the show. Elena in the book had a little sister. Back from the Dead: Twice, Jeremy has died and came back to life. The second time he came back to life, he became a medium, which is a human that sees dead people, spirits and ghosts.

characters.name: Matt Donovan
characters.description: Elena's childhood friend and first boyfriend. Starts to get involved in the supernatural side of Mystic Falls once his sister becomes one of the first victims. Adaptation Name Change: Matt's last name is Honeycutt in the books. Alcoholic Parent: His mother Kelly drinks and is very irresponsible and erratic. He has to look after her. Amicable Exes: He and Elena break up. He's willing to give Elena space after the death of her parents, but he hopes they might get back together. He manages to be friends with her. Big Brother Instinct: He is rather protective of Jeremy who is Elena's younger brother.

characters.name: Tyler Lockwood
characters.description: Matt's best friend. A hotheaded guy and one of the descendants of one of the founding families of Mystic Falls. Abusive Parents: His father was violently abusive towards him. Adaptation Name Change: His last name is Smallwood in the books. It's easy to see why this was changed for the show. Character Development: He is an annoying bully and aJerk Jockin season 1 but develops into aJerk with a Heart of Goldwho really cares about Caroline. Dirty Coward: He's good with threats but when Jeremy actually challenges him to a fight, he backs away.

characters.name: Alaric Saltzman
characters.description: The newly-arrived history teacher in Mystic Falls. He is actually a vampire hunter with connections to the Salvatore brothers. Actually Not a Vampire: When he's introduced there are several hints that he knows about the paranormal world, with several hints that he's a vampire, but he turns out to actually be a vampirehunter. Adults Are Useless:Subverted. He's one of the only adult figures in the show that is actually able to help the main cast deal with their supernatural problems. He ends up becoming aParental Substituteto Elena and Jeremy after Jenna's death and overall being aTeam Dadto the rest of the cast. The Alcoholic: After Jenna's death. He's always been a huge drinker to begin with and Damon is his drinking buddy. His drink of choice is bourbon. Ax-Crazy: His alter ego is aSerial Killer. He blacks out and kills people whenever his alter ego takes over and he's unaware of what he's doing. When Esther turns him into a vampire, he becomes extremely blood thirsty and has a strong desire to kill.

characters.name: Elena With No Humanity
characters.description: Alpha Bitch: When she loses her humanity and goes back to school, she starts showing shades of this, with her loss of emotion making her much more rude and arrogant towards her school peers. Especially in "Bring it on" when she resumes being a cheerleader and even starts throwingWild Teen Partyat her house. Anti-Villain: Becomes an antagonist in this period, with her friends trying to prevent her from truly crossing a line and opposing them when they want to cure her. Became Their Own Antithesis: In the first season, Elena frequently says that she doesn't want to be compared to Katherine. But now, with her becoming a vampire and having her humanity shut off completely, she has become more like Katherine and not just in the looks department, adopting many of Katherine's more shallow traits, such as hervanity,lack of modesty,a fashion sense geared towards blackandtendency to use sex to get what she wants. Brutal Honesty: When she turns off her humanity, she becomes very direct and blunt, without caring about other people's feelings and often hurting her friend with her newIt's All About Meattitude.Elena:It is what it is and I am what I am and want what I want. And right now I would like to feed on that girl over there. And I resent you for trying to stop me. Clingy Jealous Girl: Elena always has a bit of a jealous streak, but now it becomes extremely possessive. When Elena sees Stefan and Caroline dancing together in 4x16, Elena is obviously jealous, even though her humanity is shut off.

characters.name: Giuseppe Salvatore
characters.description: Abusive Parent: He would physically abuse his children as a method of disciplinary action. The Alcoholic: Stefan mentions how after his mother died, Giuseppe became a heavy drinker. Blood Knight: Giuseppe is always eager to kill and eradicate as many vampires as possible. Drowning My Sorrows: After Giuseppe's wife died, he used alcohol as a coping mechanism for his grief. Hoist by His Own Petard: Giuseppe tries to stake Stefan as a vampire, but instead, Giuseppe ends up fatally wounded after he was staked by the same stake that he was going to use to kill his own son.

characters.name: Zach Salvatore
characters.description: Forgotten Fallen Friend: He gets killed by Damon early in season 1, but nobody really seems to care or notice that he's gone and Damon isEasily Forgivenfor killing him by the few people that know. Neck Snap: Damon kills him by snapping his neck for revenge after Zach helped Stefan lock him up. Too Dumb to Live: Despite Stefan telling him how dangerous it is to see Damon, he still sees to it to go and taunt him, which gets him killed. Unfazed Everyman: He was a human distant nephew who lived with Stefan and Damon initially and took a lot of their antics, and other supernatural elements in stride. We Hardly Knew Ye: Dies after five episodes in season 1.

characters.name: Lily Salvatore
characters.description: Stefan and Damon's mother. Lily died of consumption in 1858. In Season Six, it is revealed Lily actually became a vampire. She eventually became a Ripper vampire like Stefan was. Lily was imprisoned in a Prison World by the Gemini Coven of witches on October 31, 1903.

characters.name: Sara Nelson
characters.description: Back for the Dead: Returns in season 8 and gets killed by Sybil in the one episode she appears in. Character Death: Stabbed by Sybil and dies in front of Stefan in season 8. Morality Pet: To Enzo and Stefan, who try to keep her safe and let down some of their emotions around her. Nice Girl: Lampshaded by Enzo. She's friendly and trusting despite herDark and Troubled Past Happily Adopted: She is content with her adoptive family and has no interest in re-seeking her roots.

characters.name: Jenna Sommers
characters.description: Adults Are Useless: Despite being the adult figure in Elena and Jeremy's life, she doesn't seem to have much luck in parenting them, and obviously can help them even less when supernatural things start happening. Adaptation Name Change: In the books, Elena's aunt's name is Judith Maxwell (nee Gilbert). On the show, she's Jenna Sommers. Killed Off for Real: She ends up being turned into a vampire and later gets killed by Klaus while attempting to throw a wrench into Klaus' plans. Older Than They Look: She's Elena and Jeremy's aunt and a generation older than them, but she looks like Elena's peer. Out of Focus: She's quickly demoted to aPlot Deviceforinviting vampires into the Gilbert house or getting compelled by themuntil she is eventually killed off in season 2.

characters.name: John Gilbert
characters.description: Heroic Sacrifice: After Klaus killed Elena, John sacrificed himself to bring her back to life as a human. Senseless Sacrifice: Sacrificing his life to resurrect Elena without her having to turn into a vampire ends up being for nothing when she dies with vampire blood in her system in the season 3 finale, and she completes the transition in the season 4 premier, becoming a vampire.

characters.name: Grayson & Miranda Gilbert
characters.description: Grayson and Miranda were Elena and Jeremy's mom and dad. Grayson was also John Gilbert's older brother and the town doctor of Mystic Falls.Grayson and Miranda were both members of the Town Council and thus knew about vampires. Grayson and Miranda were both killed in a car accident going off Wickery Bridge before the start of the series. It's later revealed that Grayson and Miranda were actually Elena's biological uncle and aunt making Jeremy her cousin. Birds of a Feather: Miranda was this with Kelly Donovan and Liz Forbes when she was alive. Dark and Troubled Past: In season 5, Grayson is revealed to have been apart of the Augustine Society and participated in the torture and experimentation on vampires. Heroic Sacrifice: Grayson gestures to Stefan to rescue Elena instead of himself when they are drowning underwater when the car crashed resulting in his death as Stefan only had enough time to save one of them.

characters.name: Johnathan Gilbert
characters.description: Elena and Jeremy's ancestor who was part of the vampire round up in Mystic Falls in 1864. Posthumous Character: Has been dead for centuries. Sanity Slippage: Driven insane by the Gilbert ring.

characters.name: Isobel Flemming-Saltzman
characters.description: Elena's birth mother, Katherine's descendant, and Alaric's ex-wife. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Isobel is icy, brunette, and aloof. Fetishized Abuser: To Alaric. She made Alaric think that she was dead for a long period of time, when in reality, she just wanted to be turned into a vampire out of selfishness. When Alaric reunited with Isobel for the first time after a long time, he called Isobel a "selfish bitch". Green-Eyed Monster: Isobel admits that she is jealous of Jenna over her relationship with Alaric. Hard-Drinking Party Girl: Isobel seems to enjoy having fun and partying.

characters.name: Liz Forbes
characters.description: Liz was the sheriff of Mystic Falls and a member of the Founder's Council. She was the ex-wife of late fellow Founder's Council member Bill Forbes, who came out as being gay, and mother of Caroline. She initially struggled to accept Caroline's identity as a vampire given her prejudices, but in time she learned to love her daughter for who she is. Accidental Murder: She accidentally killed Jeremy when she shoots at Damon, and he dodges the bullet, hitting Jeremy. Bonnie is forced to have the witch ancestors bring him back, since Liz wasn't a supernatural creature, meaning that the Gilbert ring wouldn't bring him back. Big Damn Heroes: When, in Season 3, Caroline is kidnapped and tortured by her father to try and suppress her vampirism, Liz (and Tyler) burst in and save the day. Heel Realization: She has this when she accidentally kills Jeremy when she was trying to kill Damon, and after this she accepts Caroline for what she is. Incompatible Orientation: Bill Forbes, her husband and father to Caroline, left her when he came out as a homosexual.

characters.name: Bill Forbes
characters.description: William "Bill" Forbes II was a Mystic Falls resident who returned to point out all the failings of the current Council’s attempts to keep vampires out of town, after discovering that his daughter, Caroline, is one of them. Badass Normal: He is a human with no supernatural powers, until he's murdered with the vampire blood still in his system. However he refuses to feed to complete the transition and dies. Death Equals Redemption: He accepts that Caroline is a vampire and spends his final moments with her as he is dying from not completing the transition. Face Death with Dignity: When killed with vampire blood in his system and left with the choice to either become a vampire or die, he chose the latter without hesitation, and uses his remaining time to reconcile with his daughter and ex-wife, waiting calmly for his death. Have I Mentioned I Am Gay?: The only reason that we know that he is gay, is because people keep saying that he is, not because he ever kisses men or anything. Even then he only mentions his off-screen boyfriend once when Caroline asks about him.

characters.name: Richard Lockwood
characters.description: Jerkass: He has a temper and he openly flirts with other women despite being married. Karmic Death: Is trapped in a basement with vampires he helped trap. One of thembreaks his neck. Killed Off for Real: Killed when a vampire snaps his neck.

characters.name: Carol Lockwood
characters.description: Action Mom: A mother who is willing to fight the monsters of Mystic Falls, especially to protect her son. Killed Off for Real: Carol is drowned by Klaus as revenge for Tyler's attempt to immobilize him.

characters.name: Mason Lockwood
characters.description: Tyler's uncle and a member of Jules' werewolf pack. Agent Scully: Plays up his reputation as a skeptic, but he knows for a fact that there's more out there. Awakening the Sleeping Giant: When he was first confronted by Damon, he made it clear he had no intention of being the Salvatore's enemy and would rather mind his own business. Damon tried to kill him regardless, resulting in him actively trying to get the two brothers killed. Partially subverted when it's revealed he was working for Katherine anyway; his mission just didn't involve harming them. Back from the Dead: In season 3 he appears as a ghost to Damon in order to hurt him, but also help him find a way to defeat Klaus, in order to help his nephew, who Klaus turned into a hybrid. Blatant Lies: He's not very good at hiding the fact he's a werewolf.Tyler:Your eyes, they glowed... what was that?Mason:Reflection. Off car headlamps.

characters.name: Jeffrey Lockwood-Hamilton
characters.description: Living Prop: He exists solely to be Caroline's escort to a prom committee mostly containing Founding Families members in one episode. Tangled Family Tree: His exact relationship to Tyler, his parents and Mason is unclear. What Happened to the Mouse?: Alaric eventually claims that Tyler was the last of the Lockwood's, making it unclear whether Jeffrey (and Gracie Lockwood, an unseen female relative mentioned in season 4) were killed offscreen at some point or simply weren't being counted for being more distant relatives and/or uninvolved in the supernatural.

characters.name: Logan Fell
characters.description: Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: He pretends to be nice to Jenna when he was only using her to get Johnathan Gilbert's watch for The Town Council from her house Bullying a Dragon: He riddled Damon with wooden bullets while taunting him, but left him without finishing him off. It comes back to bite him when Damon goes after him. Jerkass: According to Jenna. He does attempt to act nicer while working with the council, but his jerkassery becomes more apparent than ever once he becomes a vampire. Revenge by Proxy: Tries to turn Caroline into a vampire in order to get back at the Sheriff for covering up his death. We Hardly Knew Ye: He only appears in five episodes and then dies for good.

characters.name: Meredith Fell
characters.description: Adaptation Name Change: Her last name is Sulez in the novels. Adaptation Relationship OverhaulIn the novels, Meredith is part of Elena close circle of friends along with Bonnie and Caroline. In the series, Meredith is older than them, being part of the town's council and has never met them prior to season 3. Adaptational Wimp: In the books, Meredith is a skilled vampire hunter whose mental strength is so great that she can resist vampire compulsion and is the only personDamonadmits to being afraid of. In the series, she has no fighting capabilities. Age Lift: Her book counterpart is in the same age range as Elena, Bonnie and Caroline. In the show, she is older than them and is around Alaric's age. Brainy Brunette: She's very clever and has long brown hair.

characters.name: Tripp Cooke
characters.description: Tripp Cooke, born Thomas Vincent Fell III, is the head of Mystic Falls new militia community in Season Six whose trainees include Matt Donovan. Tripp is determined to protect his town at all costs. He is also a vampire hunter. Anti-Hero: Of Type IV. Badass Normal: When he's not training his community militia, Tripp hunts down vampires - one has to be a badass in order to do so. Big Bad: Of the first seven episodes of Season Six. Embarrassing Nickname: He changed his name from Thomas "Tripp" Vincent Fell to Tripp Cooke with the given explanation below."My dad called me "Tripp", I was such a clumsy kid that . . . I took my mom's maiden name when he bailed - I mean could you imagine?Tripp Fell?"

characters.name: Sheila Bennett
characters.description: Killed Off for Real: The effort for breaking the spell sealing the vampires in the tomb to release Stefan and Damon had greatly weakened her. She died not much time later. The Mentor: She's Bonnie's witchcraft mentor in season 1. Mentor Occupational Hazard: Ends up dying shortly after taking Bonnie as her witch apprentice. Never Mess with Granny: She might be old, but she's still a dangerous witch and isn't easily intimidated, even by vampires.

characters.name: Abby Bennett
characters.description: Parental Abandonment: She abandoned Bonnie when Mikael came to town many years ago, and imprisoning him takes away all her magic, resulting in her never going back to her family.

characters.name: Rudy Hopkins
characters.description: Rudy Hopkins was the mayor of Mystic Falls, the ex-husband of Abby Bennett Wilson and the father of Bonnie Bennett. Boyfriend-Blocking Dad: The moment he arrives in town and becomes mayor, he attempts to keep Bonnie away from her vampire friends and stop her from using magic even to help them. Though justified by the fact that he didn't want her to get killed by vampires and he was afraid that her using magic would make her end up like her mother who lost her powers and eventually ended up getting turned into a vampire and abandoned her family before that because of her witch duties. Call-Back: He later goes through with Bill Forbes's plan of putting vervain in the water supply. The Ghost: Spends three and a half seasons being unseen until season 4. Killed Off for Real: By Silas who slits his throat.

characters.name: Emily Bennett
characters.description: A powerful witch from the Bennett family in the 19th century who was Katherine Pierce's personal handmaiden. Burn the Witch!: She was executed by the Mystic Falls council via being burned at the stake. I Owe You My Life: She became Katherine's handmaiden and servant after Katherine saved her life in an event that isnot elaborated upon. Ironically, she ends up dying due to Katherine betraying her. She Knows Too Much: Katherine snitches that she's a witch to the town council, due to Katherine sees Emily as a loose end who knew too much about her to be left alive.

characters.name: Qetsiyah
characters.description: Qetsiyah (Ancient Greek: Kετσιυαη) was the oldest known ancestor of the Bennett bloodline, and a powerful Traveler witch. She was the first witch who discovered how to grant a person immortality. But then she was betrayed and tricked by her lover Silas, who wanted the immortality for himself and his true love, thus a vengeful Qetsiyah entombed him and created The Other Side to make sure he and his true love would never reunite. For the crime of creating immortality she was executed by The Travels, but even from The Other Side, she still plots her revenge.

characters.name: Vicki Donovan
characters.description: Adaptation Origin Connection: Her book counterpart Vickie Bennett wasn't related to Matt, while show Vickie is his older sister. Anyone Can Die: Was the first major character in the show to die, via aNeck Snapby Damon. Even after she cameBack from the Deadas a vampire, it didn't last and she gotKilled Off for Real. Brutal Honesty: She has a very blunt personality and likes peaking whatever is on her mind, without consideration for other people's feelings. Childish Older Sibling: Although Vicki is the older sibling, Matt is the responsible one and often reprimands Vicki for her consistent recklessness and tries his best to look out for her. Cold Turkeys Are Everywhere: After she is turned, everyone around her suddenly looks like a walking blood bag. According to Stefan, this is usual for a new vampire.

characters.name: Kelly Donovan
characters.description: Aborted Arc: The writers originally planned for her to be asuccubusback in season one, but the plot was cut for being too dark and she got written out. Alcoholic Parent: She spends most of her time getting drunk and partying and neglecting Matt because of this. Back for the Finale: In the finale. She comes back to town to meet Matt and Peter for Caroline's wedding. She actually becomes important to the plot when it's revealed she's actually dead and is an agent sent byKatherine. Generation Xerox: Retroactively, it's easy to see from where Vicki got herHard-Drinking Party Girlattitude from, as Kelly is basically an adult version of Vicki. Killed Offscreen: Shed dies at some point between beingPut on a Busand theGrand Finale. The fact that neither her son or ex-husband knew about it says a lot about her life.

characters.name: Peter Maxwell
characters.description: Peter is Matt and Vicki Donavan's father and he abandoned his family a long time ago. He is shocked when Matt walks back into his life to reconnect — and to drags him into a world of supernatural dangers. The Atoner: He is trying to make it up to Matt for abandoning him and the family years ago. Disappeared Dad: He abandoned his family when he left Mystic Falls years ago. Locked Out of the Loop: When he lived in Mystics Falls he was unaware of the existence of vampires and doesn't learn of this until Damon shows up. The Reveal: He is revealed to be Matt's father in his debut episode. This also makes him Vicki's father.

characters.name: Jonas Martin
characters.description: A doctor who moves into Mystic Falls with his family in season 2. He's actually a powerful witch in Elijah' service. Agony Beam: His main method of combat is using a pain infliction spell that causes his opponents crippling pain. He can even cast it on multiple people at once. Anti-Villain: He and his son are agents of an original vampire named Elijah, because he desired to kill Klaus, after he kidnapped his sister. Character Death: By Katherine. Papa Wolf: He's protective of his children, with the whole reason he came to Mystic Falls in the first place is to find his missing daughter and he goes ballistic once Damon ends up killing his son.

characters.name: Luka Martin
characters.description: A new student who moves into Mystic Falls with his family in season 2. Anti-Villain: He and his father are agents of an original vampire named Elijah, because he desired to kill Klaus, after he kidnapped his sister Betty and Veronica: In season 2 he's the Veronica to Jeremy's Betty for Bonnie's Archie, being the confident and charmingLove Interestin comparison to the awkward Jeremy. Commonality Connection: Part of the reason he's attracted to Bonnie is that fact she's from a witch family like him. Character Death: He was incinerated by Damon while he and his father were trying to resurrect Elijah. He ended up succumbing to his injuries, even after his father tried to cure him with a spell.

characters.name: Pastor Young
characters.description: The new leader of the Founder's Council in season four. He kills himself at the end of the premiere. Character Death: When he blows himself up, alongside the entire new council. My Death Is Just the Beginning: It's seen at the end of the episode that he knows killing himself and the Council will bring about some sort of catastrophe. And with the revelation that extremely dark magic - called 'expression' by witches - requires the sacrifice of twelve souls to work... Remember the New Guy?: He's only introduced in season 4, but he's supposedly an influential member of the Mystic Falls community, enough that he's picked to beThe Leaderif the new town council. Taking You with Me: He invites all the members of the Council (save for the members he kicked out) to his farm, and kills them all along with himself by blowing up his farmhouse. It's later revealed he did that on the orders of Professor Shane, as the death of the council members was the first massacre necessary to create the Expression Triangle.

characters.name: April Young
characters.description: April Young is the daughter of a dangerous vampire hunter Pastor Young, who first appeared in Season Four of The Vampire Diaries. She spent her childhood in Mystic Falls, but after her mother's death, her father sent her to boarding school. Following her father's death in Growing Pains, April returned to Mystic Falls and re-enrolled at Mystic Falls High School. Upon her return, she was quickly thrown into the middle of a fight between a member of the Brotherhood of the Five and the town's vampires, leading her to eventually learn about the supernatural world. Break the Cutie: In her very first episode, she was stabbed by Connor and left to bleed to death during her father's funeral in an attempt to draw out the town's vampires. After that, she's been bitten, attacked, held hostage, and compelled more times than she can count and by episode 10, she is understandably upset when she discovers that all her friends have been lying to her. Children Are Innocent: She tries to befriendRebekah. You know the sister ofKlaus. Although it's justified, she doesn't know about vampires yet. Though Rebekah does enjoy being her friend. Flat Character: She is mostly just around the other characters and is only apart of the plot because of being Pastor Young's daughter. Genki Girl: April is very hyper and spirited.

characters.name: Anna Zhu
characters.description: Action Girl: Anna is tough, capable and strong. As acenturies-old vampire, she is one of the oldest vampiresin the series and is stronger than Damon and Stefan. All There in the Manual: The prequel novelStefan Diariesreveals Anna got sick as a child and Pearl begged Katherine to turn her into a vampire to save her. Asian and Nerdy: Anna is smart, intellectual and nerdy. She is also a hardcore bookworm. She is of Chinese origin. Back from the Dead:She's back after she's staked, but only as a ghost that Jeremy sees in season three. Badass Adorable: Anna is small and petite but she is capable of defending and fighting for herself when she has to.

characters.name: Pearl
characters.description: Affably Evil: She's polite and ladylike to others for the most part and wishes no ill on the populace of Mystic Falls, but can be scheming and manipulative when she wants something. All There in the Manual: The prequel novelStefan Diariesreveals Pearl lost her entire family to a disease during the Revolutionary War; she and Anna were theSole Survivorsas Katherine sired both of them to save them from the disease. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Pearl is a dark-haired woman with a rather aloof and poised attitude. Anti-Villain: She has no real animosity towards humans and only wants to make a life for herself and her daughter. Badass Boast: When she threatens Damon.Pearl to Damon:I have 400 years on you, little boy. I'll rip you from limb to limb without even blinking, and you know it.

characters.name: Harper
characters.description: One of the vampires that was part of Pearl's group in 1864 and got locked inside the tomb with her. Apologetic Attacker: He apologizes to the random hiker that he crosses path just after his escape, and them promptly kills him for his blood and his clothes. Killed Off for Real: He's permanently killed by John Gilbert via a silent compressed air stake gun. Mugged for Disguise: After escaping the tomb, he attacks a kills a man in a forest in order to get his clothes, knowing he can't pass off as a civilian wearing clothing from 1864. Only One Name: He's only known as Harper andhis full name is never given.

characters.name: Frederick
characters.description: One of the vampires that was part of Pearl's group in 1864 and got locked inside the tomb with her. Call a Human a "Meatbag": His attitude towards humans is that they are only good as food and amusement. Dumb Muscle: He prefers quick action and violence to Pearl's pragmatic way of dealing with Mystic Falls. Killed Off for Real: He's destroyed when staked in the heart by Stefan and Elena. Only One Name: He's only known as Frederick andhis full name is never given.

characters.name: William Tanner
characters.description: The gang's history teacher at Mystic Falls High School at the beginning of the series who also coaches the football team. He is killed by Damon. 0% Approval Rating: He's a history teacher and all of the students hate him. Asshole Victim: He doesn't really show Elena, Jenna, or Jeremy any sympathy. Damon kills him just to make a point. Dropped a Bridge on Him: His death is very sudden. Jerkass: Everybody hates him. He even keeps a file on the students who annoyed him. Alaric isn't impressed when he finds it.

characters.name: Monique
characters.description: A young woman who arrives in Mystic Falls in search of her family. She is actually a con artist. Asshole Victim: Manipulates and lies to Stefan without realizing he's onto her which leads to Enzo killing her. Dark and Troubled Past: She bounced from foster home to foster home until she turned 18 and came to Mystic Falls. I Am Who?: She arrives to Mystic Falls to find out more about her family. She's lying because she looking intoSarah Salvatore'sbirth family whose identity she stole. It's all part of her scheme though. Identity Impersonator: She was a foster kid who met the real Sarah Salvatore at a summer camp when they were kids. Monique since she never had a real family, and picked the Salvatore family to impersonate on the logic that most of them were dead and couldn't question Sarah's identity. Unlucky for her, the Salvatore is a family of vampires.

characters.name: Georgie
characters.description: Georgie, an occult research intern who is working with Alaric to investigate the vault. Blindfolded Vision: She discovers that the only way to find the entrance to Sybil's cavern is to blindfold themselves and feel for it. Dark and Troubled Past: She was driving home with her friend. She was drunk and had a car accident. Her friend died and she died too, but only for a few moments. When she returned she had a tattoo of a mystical symbol. Georgie tells Alaric that she went to hell during those few moments and believes that if she ever dies again that is where she is going because of her friend's death. Dragged Off to Hell: After she dies her soul is dragged off into the darkness to the place known as hell. Killed Off for Real: Seline snaps her neck.

characters.name: Dorian
characters.description: Intern for Alaric and member of the Armory

characters.name: Lexi
characters.description: Stefan'sBest Friendand vampire mentor. Action Girl: Lexi is the first character introduced who can easily kick Damon's ass due to being a mucholder vampireand even being injected with vervain doesn't take her out completely. Action Fashionista: Lexi seems to have a penchant for clothing and fashion and she is tough and kicks ass. Badass Adorable: Lexi can be a very adorableGenki Girland she is also incredibly strong and badass, willing to attack Damon when she senses him posing a threat. Badass Boast: Lexi is normally nice and friendly, but that won't stop her from threatening to rip your throat out if you so much as cross her or anyone she cares about (i.e. Stefan).

characters.name: Bree
characters.description: Lexi and Damon's witch friend. Ethnic Magician: She's black, like most witches in the show. She possesses some powerful magic and can open vampire tombs. Hard-Drinking Party Girl: Celebrates Damon's visit by drinking and partying. Hot Witch: She's very hot, and used to date Damon. Damon reaches out to Bree when he searches for a way to release his former lover Katherine from the tomb in Mystic Falls. He tries to convince Bree to use her magic to open the tomb, but is unsuccessful. Killed Off for Real: By Damon, who rips out her heart after she sells him out to Lee, Lexi's old lover. She's deader than dead.

characters.name: Lee
characters.description: Interspecies Romance: He and Lexi used to this, with him being a human while she was a vampire. Lexi eventually turned into a vampire so they could be together forever... and then she gotKilled Off for Real. Roaring Rampage of Revenge: Lee hunts down Damon for murdering Lexi, inrevengefor Damon killing Lexi. Elena convinces Lee to spare Damon, under the logic thatIf You Kill Him, You Will Be Just Like Him!. What Happened to the Mouse?: He's never seen or mentioned again after his sole appearance, despite the fact thatDamon killed Bree soon after Lee spared Damon.

characters.name: Rose-Marie
characters.description: An old vampire who used to serve the Originals, but fell out of favor when she accidentally aided in Katherine's escape. Has been on the run from Klaus ever since. The Ageless: As a vampire, she has the ability to live forever without physically aging, which is why she looks the same despite the 500 years gap in herflashbackscenes. All Girls Want Bad Boys: According to Rose herself, she has a preference for the bad boys. Badass Boast: Rose is a braggart and talks a big game when she wants to. Badass in Distress: Rose may be a badass vampire who usually can take care of herself, trouble is the one who is hunting her down are the original vampires, who easily outclasses her.

characters.name: Enzo
characters.description: Lorenzo "Enzo" St. John was born in 1876 in England. He is a main character, minor antagonist, and anti-hero in the series. He was formerly a major recurring character in the fifth season of the series, before being promoted to main in the sixth season. He is a vampire who was previously Damon Salvatore's cellmate in the 1950's, after being captured by the Augustines. He was first mentioned by Dr. Wes Maxfield, being dubbed as the "Augustine Vampire". Affably Evil: If he likes you, Enzo can be friendly, loyal and downright pleasant. If you piss him off, he becomesFaux Affably Eviland will still be charming while planning to rip your eyes out. Ambiguously Evil: Enzo has a ratherDark and Troubled Past, therefore, the reasons for him being "evil" are slightly justifiable. Although, from what has been shown so far, Enzo seems to be more psychologically damaged than downright evil. Ax-Crazy: Only mildly. Although it is understandable why Enzo is so psychologically unhinged due to the fact that he was brutally tortured for years by Augustine. Being Tortured Makes You Evil: Downplayed, being tortured didn't make Enzo evil, as much as furious with Damon for leaving him behind.

characters.name: Ivy
characters.description: A young woman Stefan started dating before the start of Season Six. She is later turned into a vampire by Enzo. Animal Motifs: She loves dogs. Cassandra Truth: When she asks to know more about Stefan,he tells her he's a vampire. She believes he's joking and scolds him. Kick the Dog: She tells Stefan it's her fault she's now a vampire when Enzo is the one who turned her. Caroline was going to teach her how to be a vampire, but Ivy wants to go to a party and snaps her neck. Killed Off for Real: Captured by Tripp Cooke andis killed by being transported by him in his vampire-proof van over the Travelers' anti-magic border.

characters.name: Amara
characters.description: Silas lover, handmaiden of Qetsiyah, and the world's first immortal woman. She's the progenitor of the Petrova Doppelgänger bloodline. All for Nothing: Amara desired immortality and to be an immortal being all out of love and so she could spend an eternity with Silas. Sadly, her immortal life turned out to be nothing but tragedy and suffering.Instead of living an eternal happily ever after with her soulmate as she originally wanted and intended, Amara ended up having her true love Silas believe that she was dead due to Qetsiyah telling Silas that he had killed her. And then Silas ended up entombed in darkness and starved for centuries and centuries. Not only did Qetsiyah fake Amara's death to Silas, but Qetsiyah ended up desiccating and entombing Amara and using her as the physical anchor for the Other Side, a purgatory for supernatural beings who have died to go to once they die. Qetsiyah created this supernatural purgatory as a way for Silas' soul to be trapped with her for all time and separated from Amara shall he take the cure and die a mortal death. As a result of being the anchor to the Other Side, Amara ended up experiencing very single supernatural death for over two millennia, while being trapped in her own body and starving and desiccating. After Amara is finally found by Silas and is reawakened after 2,000 years, Amara becomes mortal again after drinking the cure from Silas' blood. She desires death more than anything else and does everything she can to kill herself due to her suffering. Amara confesses to Silas that she strongly loves him and that she will always love him but that her desire to die and end her suffering is just as strong and powerful as her love for Silas. Amara begs Silas to kill her himself, but Silas struggles with doing so. Silas ends up being killed by his doppelgänger Stefan win he is stabbed with a knife. He then crosses over to the Other Side through Amara. After Silas dies, Qetsiyah ends up transferring the anchor from Amara to

characters.name: Tatia Petrova
characters.description: Tatia Petrova was born in 10th Century A.D. She was a Petrova doppelgänger with Niklaus and Elijah Mikaelson fell in love in the late 10th/early 11th century. She is the first doppelgänger to be created from Amara's line after she was turned into a true immortal in 1st century B.C. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Tatia comes off as aProper Ladywho has an air of elegance and sophistication. Damsel in Distress: Since it seems as though Esther had used Tatia in the spell that helped to turn her entire family into vampires and also in the spell to bind Klaus' werewolf side, which is believed to have killed her, it could be assumed that Tatia was this.Esther revealed that she never killed Tatia and never wanted to, she had hoped she and Elijah would hit it off, but since he was new to his vampirism, he accidentally killed her when he lost control of the bloodlust. Esther revealed that she never killed Tatia and never wanted to, she had hoped she and Elijah would hit it off, but since he was new to his vampirism, he accidentally killed her when he lost control of the bloodlust. Doppelgänger: Tatia is known to be the first doppelgänger of Amara, the world's first immortal woman. Her doppelgängers are Katherine Pierce, Elena Gilbert and possibly other unknown Petrova doppelgängers. Like Katherine, Tatia passed down the doppelganger gene through her bloodline.

characters.name: Katherine Pierce
characters.description: One of the main antagonists of the series. Elena's identical ancestor and ex-lover of the Salvatore brothers. She's one of the Petrova Doppelgängers, having turned herself into a vampire and a hardened survivalist to escape from Klaus.

characters.name: Nadia Petrova
characters.description: Nadia Petrov is Katherine Pierce's long-lost daughter that is over 500 years old. She is a vampire and a member of The Travellers. Action Fashionista: Nadia seems to love fashion and clothing. Action Girl: Nadia is capable of kicking ass and defending herself. The AgelessNadia is a vampire. She is capable of living forever without physically aging. She is over 500 years old, making her one of the oldest vampires in the series. All Women Are Lustful: Nadia seems to enjoy many sexual encounters.

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.description: Klaus is a 1,000+ year old hybrid, who is half-vampire and half-werewolf. Originally, Klaus, like all of the other Original vampires, was born a human until Esther and Mikael bestowed the curse of vampirism/immortality onto him and the rest of his siblings.

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.description: An Original vampire, Elijah is the most sophisticated, noble and moral as well as highly hypocritical member of his family. He alternately works for Klaus and against him throughout the series. He was once in love with Katherine and tried to save her from his brother but she betrayed him.

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.description: Rebekah Mikaelson is a member of the Original Family who had a romance with Stefan in the 1920s. Klaus staked her when she chose Stefan over him. She was unstaked by Klaus in an effort to find out why his hybrids were failing.

characters.name: Finn Mikaelson
characters.description: The second oldest of the Original siblings and Sage's lover.

characters.name: Kol Mikaelson
characters.description: The third-youngest of the Originals, notable for being even moreAx-Crazyand violent than Klaus.

characters.name: Freya Mikaelson
characters.description: Freya Mikaelson is the oldest of the Mikaelson siblings.

characters.name: Henrik Mikaelson
characters.description: Henrik Mikaelson is the youngest of the Mikaelson siblings.

characters.name: Mikael
characters.description: Mikael is one of the Original Vampires, the Original Vampire Hunter, and is the vampire who hunts vampires. He is the husband of the Original Witch Esther, and the father of Freya, Finn, Elijah, Kol, Rebekah and Henrik Mikaelson.

characters.name: Esther
characters.description: One of the most powerful witches in history and the wife of Mikael and former lover of Ansel. She is the mother of Freya, Finn, Elijah, Niklaus, Kol, Rebekah and Henrik.

characters.name: Trevor
characters.description: An old vampire who used to serve the Originals, but fell out of favor when she accidentally aided in Katherine's escape. Has been on the run from Klaus ever since. The Ageless: As a vampire, he has the ability to live forever without physically aging, which is why he looks the same despite the 500 years gap in herflashbackscenes. Badass in Distress: Trevor may be a badass vampire who usually can take care of himself, trouble is the one who is hunting him down are the original vampires, who easily outclasses him. Dark and Troubled Past: Rose and Trevor had been running for over 500 years because of Klaus and Katherine. Fool for Love: He's seduced by the human Katherine, who convinces him to help her escape Klaus instead of giving her up. Even 500 years later, he still seems to have a thing for her, since he views Elena as aLust Object.

characters.name: Maddox
characters.description: A powerful witch and a member of Klaus' inner circle. Co-Dragons: He shares the position of being Klaus' main enforcer with Greta in season 2. Neck Snap: Get killed by Damon sneaking behind him and snaping his neck. Mauve Shirt: Despite beingThe Dragonfor Klaus he doesn't get much characterization or motives, just acting as hisstoicminion until he gets killed by Damon. Mind Over Matter: Telekinesis is his most commonly used spells, and he's constantly getting people blow across a room with a swipe of his hand.

characters.name: Greta Martin
characters.description: The witch daughter of Jonas Martin and a loyal servant of Klaus, who is in charge of breaking the Hybrid curse. Co-Dragons: She shares the position of being Klaus' main enforcer with Maxwell in season 2. Evil All Along: Jonah and Luke assume that Klaus kidnapped Greta into his service, but it turns out she serves him willingly and seems to enjoy doing his dirty work, such as using Jenna as aHuman Sacrifice. Hot Witch: She's a very attractive witch with a sultry demeanor. Neck Snap: She is killed by Damon during the ritual when he superspeeds behind her and breaks her neck.

characters.name: Gloria
characters.description: A powerful witch and a old acquaintance of Klaus who he seeks for help in season 3. Agony Beam: She's capable of performing powerful Pain Infliction spells capable of taking down vampires just by looking at them. Ethnic Magician: She's black, like most witches in the series. Older Than They Look: Looks to be around her 40s, but is actually over 100 years old. She's managed to slow her aging process using her magic. Only One Name: She has no surname that we know of. Only known as Gloria.

characters.name: Tony
characters.description: A member of Klaus Hybrid pack in season 3. Co-Dragons: He shared the position of Klaus' top minion with Mindy in his hybrid pack. Deadpan Snarker: The few lines he has are sarcastic one-liners towards Elena and Alaric.Tony:[after attacking Elena and Alaric with his car]There I go again. Bumping into people... Hybrid Monster: He's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Killed Off for Real: Is permanently destroyed by Jeremy, who shoots him with an arrow anddecapitates him.

characters.name: Mindy
characters.description: A member of Klaus Hybrid pack in season 3. Brainwashed: Gets compelled by Mikael into working against Klaus. Co-Dragons: She shared the position of Klaus' top minion with Tony in his hybrid pack. Hybrid Monster: She's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Killed Off for Real: Is permanently destroyed by Stefan, whodecapitates herwith a saw after he turns on Klaus.

characters.name: Daniel Warren
characters.description: A member of Klaus Hybrid pack in season 3. The Dragon: Becomes Klaus' new second-hand after Tony and Mindy get killed, mostly because he'sthe only survivor left.He doesn't last long either. Hybrid Monster: He's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Killed Off for Real: Is permanently destroyed by Elijah, who rips out his heart. Sole Survivor: Was the sole surviving hybrid left after the rest of the pack was killed or used as sacrifices in Atticus Shane's plan.

characters.name: Dean
characters.description: A member of Klaus Hybrid pack in season 3. Hybrid Monster: He's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Killed Off for Real: Is permanently destroyed by Connor, who blows a hole in his chest. Only One Name: He's only known as Dean andhis full name is never given. Sacrificial Lion: A sympathetic member of Klaus' pack whose death encourages Tyler and Hayley to try to help the other hybrids.

characters.name: Jules
characters.description: The alpha werewolf of the pack Mason was part of who comes to Mystic Falls in search of him. Alas, Poor Villain: While she was an antagonist, it's hard not to feel sorry for her when she gets sacrificed by Klaus. Asshole Victim: An antagonist in season 2 who tortured Caroline and killed Rose, but gets used as aHuman Sacrificeby Klaus. Dark Action Girl: She is very strong and a capable fighter. Fur Against Fang: She's a werewolf who has a particular dislike of vampires.

characters.name: Brady
characters.description: Jules' werewolf lover and a member of her pack Character Death: He was killed by Stefan while trying to capture Elena for her blood. Fur Against Fang: Just like his lover, he's a werewolf with a special enmity against vampires. Jerkass: Clearlydespises vampires, gleefully tortured Caroline while she was his prisoner, and was overall very inclined to use violent methods. Only One Name: He's only known by the name Brady andhis full name is never given.

characters.name: Stevie
characters.description: A member of Jules' pack. Character Death: He was killed by Elijah when he purges Jules' pack. Fur Against Fang: Just like his lover, he's a werewolf with a special enmity against vampires. Only One Name: He's only known by the name Stevie andhis full name is never given. Smug Snake: He's just as arrogant as Jules, but doesn't really have the strength to back it up. When Elijah shows up and slaughters the pack, he just cowers and hides.

characters.name: Paige
characters.description: The leader of a Werewolf pack that Klaus tries to take over and turn them all into hybrids. Came Back Wrong: To say Klaus' attempt to turn her into a Hybrid went wrong would be putting it lightly, as she becomes catatonic and starts cryingTears of Blood, and when he snaps out of it he goesberserkand tries to attack Klaus, forcing her to kill her permanently. Forced Transformation: Klaus gives her the choice tojoin him or die, and she'd much rather die than be turned into a vampire. Unfortunately, he was lying and he forcefully feeds her his blood before killing her Interspecies Romance: Her lover is a human, who stays in her werewolf pack to be with her. Killed Off for Real: Killed twice by Klaus, once to turn her into a hybrid, then when she went berserk and attacked him, with the second death being permanent.

characters.name: Derek
characters.description: A human member of Paige's werewolf pack. Only One Name: He's only known as Derek andhis full name is never given. Red Shirt: Doesn't get time to show much of his personality before being killed off by Klaus. Token Human: The only human in Paige's werewolf pack, due to being her boyfriend.
