Unfortunately for him, this makes him into a bloodbag when Klaus takes over the pack and needs human blood for his hybrids. We Hardly Knew Ye: Dies in the episode he's introduced.

characters.name: Ray Sutton
characters.description: A werewolf member of Paige's werewolf pack. Came Back Wrong: To say Klaus' attempt to turn him into a Hybrid went wrong would be putting it lightly, as he becomes catatonic and starts cryingTears of Blood, and when he snaps out of it he goesberserkand runs away, forcing Stefan to track him down and put him down. Cold-Blooded Torture: Stefan tortures him by using him as a dart board and throwing wolfsbane-coated darts all over his body every time he refused to answer a question. Killed Off for Real: Killed by Klaus to turn him into a hybrid, and then put down permanently by Stefan once he went berserk and attacked Damon. Sacrificial Lamb: He dies to establish Klaus still needs more from Elena/Katherine in order to have his hybrid werewolves, else they willCame Back Wrong.

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.description: A werewolf estranged from her clan who came to Mystic Falls. She helps Tyler break his sire bond with Klaus and form his own pack.

characters.name: Kimberley
characters.description: A hybrid werewolf that was forced to be part of Klaus pack, but broke out of her sire bond to him with Tyler and Hayley's help. Affectionate Nickname: She's nicknamed Kim. Defector from Decadence: He used to hybrid from Klaus' pack, but defected and overcome the Sire Bond with the help of Tyler and Hayley. Hybrid Monster: She's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Off with Her Head!: She's killed by Klaus via decapitation.

characters.name: Adrian
characters.description: A hybrid werewolf that was forced to be part of Klaus pack, but broke out of her sire bond to him with Tyler and Hayley's help. Defector from Decadence: He used to hybrid from Klaus' pack, but defected and overcome the Sire Bond with the help of Tyler and Hayley. The Generic Guy: Doesn't have much of a personality other than hanging around Kim and following her orders. Hybrid Monster: He's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Only One Name: He's only known as Adrian andhis full name is never given.

characters.name: Chris
characters.description: A hybrid werewolf that was forced to be part of Klaus pack, but broke out of her sire bond to him with Tyler and Hayley's help. Defector from Decadence: He used to hybrid from Klaus' pack, but defected and overcome the Sire Bond with the help of Tyler and Hayley. Hybrid Monster: He's a hybrid vampire/werewolf sired from Klaus' bloodline. Only One Name: He's only known as Chris andhis full name is never given. Red Shirt: Doesn't get much personality before being killed off.

characters.name: Connor Jordan
characters.description: The new vampire hunter in town, show's up after the deaths of Pastor Young and the remaining members of the Founder's Council. However, there is more to him than meets the eye, as it's later revealed he was sent to Mystic Falls by Professor Atticus Shane to kill vampires. Connor is revealed to be a member of a supernatural sect known as the Brotherhood of the Five. He is later killed by Elena. Anti-Villain: Of the well-intentioned extremist variety, as he views the end goal of riding the world of vampires to be worth the occasional human casuality here and there as evidenced by his risking April Young's life to use as bait, then hers as well as Matt's and Jeremy's. Big Bad: Looking like it in Season 4. Though due to the show's track record, he's probably not. The Bus Came Back: In late Season 4,as a ghost to cure/kill Silas.

characters.name: Galen Vaughn
characters.description: A vampire hunter as well as a member of the Brotherhood of the Five. Relentless, tactical, cunning though charming and handsome Galen is tough as nails. Unlike Connor Jordan, he has full knowledge of the Five's true supernatural purpose: to cure Silas, the progenitor of the Salvatore doppelganger bloodline and the world's first immortal being and kill him. Crazy-Prepared: Galen is a tactical individual, ready for any situation, armed to the teeth, more so than Connor even holding weapons to incapacitate Rebekah Mikaelson, anOriginalvampire. Disc-One Final Boss: Of the secondary chapter of Season 4,until he's left to die by starvation by Rebekah. Hero Antagonist: The purpose of the Five to cureBig BadSilas and kill him. Jerkass: He is determined to fulfil the Five's goal and was perfectly willing to harm others as collateral damage to accomplish this stabbing Bonnie, torturing Damon to use as leverage.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: The leader of the Brotherhood of the Five in the early 12th century who daggered The Originals save for Klaus. Back from the Dead: Thanks to Bonnie lifting the veil, he's resurrected in the present day Character Death: In the past he was killed by Klaus after he failed to assassinate him due to him being a hybrid. In the modern-day, he's killed again by an Original, this time by Rebekah when she sets one of his traps on him. Due to the Dead: He was buried along with his sword by Rebekah in the church that they picked for their marriage in Italy. The Fundamentalist: He was fervently dedicated to the cause to destroy all vampires, even hosting public vampire executions to demonstrate the threat they posed to humanity. When he found that his fiancee Rebekah was a vampire, he didn't hesitate to have her and her entire family daggered.

characters.name: Professor Atticus Shane
characters.description: Atticus is a professor or teacher that teaches at the university in which Bonnie's grandmother taught at. He is aware of the existence of vampires, witches and werewolves and is an associate of The Five as he was the one who sent Connor to Mystic Falls in the first place. He has plans to help Bonnie with her guilt, although he has plans for her.

characters.name: Rayna Cruz
characters.description: Rayna Cruz was a recurring character and the primary antagonist in the seventh season of The Vampire Diaries. She was a Shamanic Huntress hailing around the 19th Century, the daughter of Vicente Cruz, who was a member of the Brotherhood of the Five, and was a fierce vampire huntress whose sole purpose was to eradicate and incarcerate Vampires within the Phoenix Stone. After being forced to kill her father by Julian, she became enhanced by a tribe of shamans to get vengeance on Julian, his Heretic family, and all vampires. Her main target was Stefan Salvatore as he was stabbed by her when she attempted to kill Damon, marking him with her sword, allowing her to find him anywhere and compelling her to kill him. She was willing to kill everyone, no matter the species, that dare to stand in her way. She also bared a striking resemblance to the late Elena Gilbert although she does not seem to be of any relation to Elena or any of her Doppelgängers. Action Girl: She had quite the body count to her name. Anti-Magic: She's immune to direct offensive magic, as shown when sheNo-SellBonnie using telekinesis on her.

characters.name: Markos
characters.description: The leader of the Travelers who plots to undo a curse that was cast on them that prevents them from using traditional Spirit magic and settling down in one place. By undoing the curse, they undo every other magic cast by witches. He needs the mystical blood of thedoppelgangersin order to do so. After his resurrection from the Other side, the supernatural purgatory begins to fall apart, putting the souls of all dead supernatural being in danger. Markos was born in the 5th century, making him the fourth oldest character in the TVD universe after Silas, Qetsiyah and Amara. Back from the Dead: The Travelers main goal for most of season 5 is his resurrection, and they finally succeed via amass sacrifice ritualthat brings him back from the Other Side. Bad Boss: He clearly doesn't value the lives of his fellow Travelers, and even gets hisNumber Twoslow casually killed in aDispel Magicexperiment. Big Bad: He's the main antagonist of the later half of season 5. The Chessmaster: Claims to be the reason Stefan and Elena ended up together in the first place.

characters.name: Sloan
characters.description: The de facto leader of the Travelers while Markos remains dead. Deadpan Snarker: She actually demonstrates some sarcastic wit at some pointsSloan:''[upon being asked if they're moving location]]' People don't call us travelers for our mileage points. The Dragon: She acts asThe Leaderof the Travelers until Markos' resurrection. The Heavy: She's thede factoleader of the Travelers and main antagonist for most of the latter half of season 5 until the resurrection ofBig BadMarkos in the final episodes. Iron Lady: She's pragmatic, tough and ruthless when leading the Travelers, not afraid of taking risks,sacrificing her people, or even putting her own life at risk.

characters.name: Julian
characters.description: A member of the Travelers who takes over Tyler's body as a passenger. Body Surf: He takes over Tyler's body so he can beThe Molein the Mystic Fall gang. His real body is never even seen. Cold-Blooded Torture: Matt and Jeremy torture him with wolfsbane in order to tell them Markos' plan and he actually quickly submits to the torture. Happily Married: To Maria, to the point he gets into aRoaring Rampage of Revengeonce he learns the Mystic Falls Gang caused her death. Hero Killer: Ends up killing Stefan by ripping out his heart with his hybrid strength inrevengefor Maria's death, though Stefan gets resurrected by theSeason Finale.

characters.name: Maria
characters.description: A member of the Travelers and Julian's wife. All Women Are Lustful: She is very appreciative of how attractive Tyler's body is and seems to even seems tobe planning to sleep with Julian while he's possessing Tyler. Character Death: She's killed by Liv and Luke Parker when they make her vehicle crash with their telekinetic powers. Happily Married: To Julian, to the point she's willing to betray the Travelers for his sake. Mistreatment-Induced Betrayal: She betrays Markos when he sentences her husband to death, helping Stefan and Elena escape from the Travelers.

characters.name: Nadia
characters.description: Nadia Petrova is Katherine Pierce's long-lost daughter that is over 500 years old. She is a vampire and a member of The Travellers.

characters.name: Gregor
characters.description: A member of the Travelers and Nadia's lover and partner. Battle Couple: Works alongside his lover Nadia while trying to capture Katherine from Damon and Elena. Body Surf: Uses his traveler magic to become a Passenger in Matt's body, which allows him to live on after his real body has died... until Katherine uses the Traveler knife on him. Fool for Love: While it'sambiguous if Nadia truly cared for him, he clearly was unwisely ok with her derailing The Traveler's plans for Silas and Katherine for her personal goals, which is especially egregious when said derailing involved herkilling his original bodyand getting him stuck in Matt's. He later reveals his orders were to kill Katherine, but he seemingly didn't go through with them for Nadia's sake. Killed Off for Real: First his real body is killed by Nadia so they can "prove" their loyalty to Silas, and he gets stuck possessing Matt's body. Then Katherine expels his spirit from Matt's body with the Traveler knife, which effectively kills him for good.

characters.name: Mia
characters.description: A member of the Travelers that helps Katherine take control of Elena's body. Attack on the Heart: Katherine rips out her heart to kill her after she hasno further use for her. Body Surf: Her specialty, although she doesn't do it herself, she's the Traveler assigned to assist Katherine and Nadia take over Elena's body. Mauve Shirt: She has someNominal Importanceand a subplot helping Katherine and Nadia, but doesn't get much characterization and is killed as soon as her role is done. Only One Name: Her only known name is Mia andher full name is never given.

characters.name: Silas
characters.description: Silas (Ancient Greek: Σίλας), known as The World's First Immortal Being, was an extremely powerful warlock and a former member of The Travellers who became one of the world's two first, oldest and most powerful immortal beings along with his true love, Amara, The World's First Immortal Woman.

characters.name: Characters / The Vampire Diaries Universe Stefan Salvatore
characters.description: 10-Minute Retirement: At the start of season 6 and after he was brought back from the dead, Stefan left Mystic Falls to start over after Damon died to save his life. Unfortunately for him, his life of peace was ripped away from him when Enzo lambasted him for running away and not playing his role as the towns hero. He further antagonized Stefan by killing his girlfriend, Ivy, which ultimately forced Stefan to return home. The Ace: During his human years, he was practically the golden boy. He was a good student, was his parents favorite child, well-liked and respected by everyone and popular with the ladies. Stefan being nearly good at everything since his human years is what made Damon feelAlways Second Best. Action Survivor: Even before he was turned into a vampire, flashbacks showed that Stefan was very capable of handling himself during a battle or fight. Action Hero: Stefan is involved in the middle of all of the action in the series. Since he is a vampire who has super strength and speed, he's one of the best physical fighters . He can take on other vampires and supernatural creatures with ease. Act of True Love: Stefan sacrifices his humanity and his relationship with Elena in order to save Damon from dying from a fatal werewolf bite at the end of season 2. He chooses to becomeThe Dragonfor Klaus and serve him in order to protect Elena and the town of Mystic Falls from Klaus' wrath. In the series finale, Stefan sacrifices his life (as a human) in order to save the entire town of Mystic Falls from being incinerated by Katherine and gives his brother the cure so that he can live a human life with Elena, something that he has wanted for himself in the past. Stefan's act solidifies his status asThe Heroof the series. Knight in Shining Armor: Stefan is heroic, saves the day, fights the bad guys, knows how to charm the ladies, has a strong sense of nobleness and honour and is chivalrous towards the opposite sex. Stefan especially fits this trope in regards toElenaas

characters.name: Characters / The Vampire Diaries Universe Silas
characters.description: Actually, I Am Him: In the season four finale,Silas reveals to Stefan that he is in fact Silas, the very first immortal being. Silas then reveals to Stefan that he created the immortality spell and as a consequence, a doppelgänger line was created for Silas. Silas revealed to Stefan that Stefan is his shadow self or doppelgänger. Alas, Poor Villain: WhenSilas dies and crosses over to the Other Side where he ends up trapped with Qetsiyah for eternity and separated from his true love Amara forever (who had died and crossed over to the afterlife and found true peace), one can't help but feel sorry for Silas. He spent 2,000 years starving and fossilizing in darkness as an immortal being, an immortal and eternal life that Silas wanted to spend with Amara in the first place, and all his suffering and misery turned out to be for nothing in the end as he didn't even find true peace with his soulmate in the end. All for Nothing: Exaggerated. Silas starved and desiccated while being entombed in darkness for over2,000 yearsandresisted the cure for immortality in order to not become a mortal, die and cross over to the Other Side so that his soul would be eternally trapped with Qetsiyah, all out of his strong love and devotion for and to Amara. Silas was eventually freed by the Mystic Falls gang so that he would roam freely on Earth and possibly unleash hell upon Earth. Silas caused much chaos, destruction and turmoil for many Mystic Falls residents all because he wanted to take the cure, become mortal again, have Bonnie drop the Veil to the Other Side, destroy the Other Side permanently and die so that Silas could be reunited and find peace with his true love Amara in the afterlife.Unfortunately, none of this happened. Qetsiyah brought herself back to life from the Other Side, planning on finishing what The Brotherhood Of The Five couldn't accomplish 1,000 years ago, which is the mission for them to find Silas, cure him and kill him so that he would end up on the Other Side wit
